commands.step: Set preview
Wait for complete Netlify HTML cutover
commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  root=$(curl -L -sS --max-time 6 "$PUBLIC_PAGES_URL/" || true)
  config=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\t%{redirect_url}' --max-time 6 "$PUBLIC_PAGES_URL/config/" || true)
  access=$(curl -L -sS --max-time 6 "$PUBLIC_PAGES_URL/access/" || true)
  config_status=${config%%$'\t'*}
  config_location=${config#*$'\t'}
  if [[ "$root" == *'id="environmentTrack"'* \
    && "$config_status" =~ ^30[12378]$ \
    && "$config_location" == "$PUBLIC_PAGES_URL/access/"* \
    && "$access" == *'Confirmar acesso ao configurador'* ]]; then
    echo "Netlify preview public root and anonymous access redirect ready"
    break
  fi
  sleep 3
done
[[ "$root" == *'id="environmentTrack"'* \
  && "$config_status" =~ ^30[12378]$ \
  && "$config_location" == "$PUBLIC_PAGES_URL/access/"* \
  && "$access" == *'Confirmar acesso ao configurador'* ]]
